title: Los Baños White Gold corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Los Baños White Gold corn: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: Los Baños White Gold corn is a white hybrid corn variety for Luzon. 102 to 104 days to harvest, 6.4 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
keywords: Los Baños White Gold corn variety
excerpt: Los Baños White Gold corn is a white hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2005 as NSIC 2005 Cn 167. It takes 102 to 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 6.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 6.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** Luzon, in the dry season.

blocks.text: Key facts about Los Baños White Gold corn

blocks.caption: Key facts of Los Baños White Gold

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Los Baños White Gold corn takes 102 to 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 25 white hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 101.1 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6.44 t/ha beats the average of its group, 6.21. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 15 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 81.25 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant Los Baños White Gold corn

It is recommended for Luzon in the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Los Baños White Gold?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
